text:
Lina: Quick sync — we need to lock speaker onboarding + last-mile swag for Tues meetup at The Loft. Main asks: pickup window for swag, who owns slides + benchmark blurb, and launch post cadence for pre/post event. Who can take what?
Emma: I can own speaker onboarding and collecting slides. Will put together a 1-slide template + a short blurb prompt for benchmarks.
Raj: I got load-in covered (table, power, 2 chairs). Working on transport for the crates. ETA on courier?
OpsBot: Courier booking submitted. Pickup window tentatively 2024-07-16 14:00 PDT — courier ID X12345. Locker reserved at venue for crates.
Lina: Nice — Raj can you confirm someone will be onsite at pickup if the courier shows early? Also need a contact for the venue on dropoff.
Raj: Yep I'll be onsite for pickup. Venue contact is Sara (events@theloft). Adding her to calendar invite.
Michelle: For the marketing side: want a concise benchmark narrative we can use in the launch post and a slightly longer version for the webinar follow-up. Proposal: 2-sentence headline for social, 3-paragraph for the blog. Also need a 1-slide chart (latency vs cost) — can the ML team export a PNG?
Emma: I'll draft the 2-sentence headline + a 3-paragraph blog outline by EOD tomorrow. For slides, use this template for speakers to fill:
```
- Speaker name
- Talk title
- 3 bullets: key takeaway, demo flow, benchmark callouts
- Slide with single chart image (PNG) named: speakername_benchmark.png
```
Raj: Can we add a line to the template asking speakers to confirm any code or demo keys they need network access for? Last meetup we had a VPN issue.
Emma: Good call — adding a short checklist item in the template: `network keys / ports / admin access needed`
DevExBot: Calendar placeholder created: "Meetup — speaker check-in & swag handoff" 2024-07-16 15:00 PDT. Invite sent to participants. :calendar:
Lina: Webinar tie-in — recommend a 30-45 min panel 2 weeks after the meetup to capture leads. Michelle, can you own webinar landing page + registration flow?
Michelle: I can. Will spin up an eventbrite + landing page draft. Need the 2-sentence headline and one image from Emma. Also want to collect T-shirt sizes and role (engineer/pm/other) on the lead form.
Emma: Got it. I'll include a short CTA for post-event webinar and a checkbox on the speaker form to opt-in leads for follow-up.
Lina: Swag specifics — we ordered tees (S-XL) + 250 stickers + 100 postcards. Courier confirmed. Raj, can you verify the counts on arrival?
Raj: Will verify and upload a quick photo to the thread when crates open.
OpsBot: Reminder set: check-in with courier 2 hours before pickup.
Michelle: Lead routing — plan: QR scan -> Typeform -> auto-tag by interest (benchmarks/product/partner). Send to SF SDR queue and marketing inbox. Who can set up the webhook?
Emma: I can wire the Typeform to HubSpot via zapier today, tag mapping: `benchmarks`, `demo-request`, `partner`.
Lina: Perfect. Final asks: Emma draft + share template by EOD, Michelle landing page draft by Friday, Raj confirms physical counts on arrival, OpsBot keep courier on schedule. Anything else?
Raj: Do we have a backup set of stickers in case of extra walkups?
Lina: We do — stash of 50 extra in the office labeled "meetup spare".
Michelle: I'll prepare the post-send nurture: 3 emails (thanks + slides, webinar invite, product highlights).
Emma: Putting everything into the shared folder: `marketing/meetups/loft-july/`. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:
Lina: Great — thanks everyone. If any blocker DM me.
